description:
Classic British titanium craftsmanship. Clean, minimalist design.

Handcrafted in Sussex, the Enigma Esprit is a traditional titanium road frame featuring a horizontal top tube, short-drop rim brakes and semi-internal cable routing designed for Shimano Di2 electronic shifting.

Unlike the externally routed 54cm version, this 56cm frame has no rear rack mounts, creating a cleaner, more streamlined appearance. Built from Grade 9 3Al/2.5V titanium, it features a straight 1⅛" head tube, BSA threaded bottom bracket and clearance for tyres up to 28mm.

Finished in satin bead with contrasting brushed logos.

SAVE 25% – LIMITED AVAILABILITY

Brand new and unused, complete with a full Enigma warranty.

Size & Availability

56cm – Only one available.
